description: Tears at the target with giant crushing claws. 25% Critical Hit.

name: Poison Tail
description: Strikes with a venomous tail, inflicting POISON on foe.

name: Shadow Sneak
description: Extends the user shadow to strike first. Deals +2 DMG if faster.

name: Shadow Claw
description: Slashes with a sharp shadow claw. 25% Critical Hit.

name: Draco Meteor
description: Summons celestial dragon comets onto the target with immense power.

name: Arm Thrust
description: Attacks with consecutive thrusting arms (2-5 hits).

name: Fake Out
description: An unexpected slap that catches the foe off guard, causing FLINCH.

name: Knock Off
description: Knocks down the opponent with a swift hit. Boost deals +3 DMG.

name: Night Slash
description: Slashes the foe as fast as shadows fall. 25% Critical Hit.

name: Silver Wind
description: Attacks with a wind of shimmering powdery scales. Deals +3 DMG if faster.

name: Weather Ball
description: Gathers natural energy from the weather. Boost increases damage by +4.

name: Astonish
description: Shocks the foe with an unexpected ghostly fright, causing FLINCH.

name: Bounce
description: Bounces high into the air and crashes down, inflicting PARALYZE.

name: Spore
description: Releases a cloud of hypnotic fungal spores that induce SLEEP.

name: Volt Tackle
description: Electrifies the user body and tackles at lightning speed with recoil.

name: Teeter Dance
description: Performs an uncoordinated wobbly dance that inflicts CONFUSION.
